name: Crimson Apprentice

abilities.name: Pool of Shadow
abilities.description: The enemy slams their staff into the ground, creating a pool of dark energy all around them, indicated by a circular AoE, which lingers for a time and deals constant damage when inside.

abilities.name: Shadeway
abilities.description: The enemy casts a spell that launches two slow and heavier-hitting projectiles. This can be interrupted to set the enemy off-balance.

abilities.name: Shadowy Duplicate
abilities.description: The enemy teleports a short distance away, leaving a Shadow in their place. The shadow will cast Fright Force dealing minor magic damage until it is killed. When killed, it explodes and leaves a Pool of Shadow in its place.

abilities.name: Summon Vampiric Mines
abilities.description: Crimson Apprentice summons five vampiric mines in a pattern like the deprecated Daedric Minefield skill morph, albeit larger.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: At 75%, 50% and 25% Health, the Crimson Apprentice will teleport not far away in the maze, a discreet trail shows where he is going then a tall red light shows above him. A Blood/Gore Storm dealing continuous low magic damage follows you and will spawn a Lesser Coagulant if it hits you. At the 75% phase, one Unstable Specter will appear, two at the 50% phase and three at the 25% phase, and all disappear when a phase ends. The Crimson Apprentice is invincible, channeling and healing himself over time (Blood Empowerment). Once you find the Crimson Apprentice, you have to interrupt him and he'll go back to the altar arena with a small damage shield.

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: Welcome to my domain. Careful not to lose yourself.
dialogue.trigger: When you begin combat with him

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: Come into the maze and find me…if you can.
dialogue.trigger: When he teleports in the hedge maze, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.trigger: Finding him for the first time

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: Where could I be? Come into the maze and find out.
dialogue.trigger: When he teleports again the second time into the maze

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: Next time it won't be so easy.

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: I grow tired of this. You will die in this maze.
dialogue.trigger: When he teleports the third time into the maze, this making multiple shadow copies of himself and unleashing trailing power attacks

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: Am I to the left? Or perhaps to the right?

dialogue.speaker: Crimson Apprentice
dialogue.line: You'll never get out of here alive….
dialogue.trigger: Finishing him off, he will curse you

summary: The Crimson Apprentice is a Breton boss that can be encountered in the Spire of the Crimson Coin. He is seen strangling a Mercenary Butcher at a distance. When entering combat the mercenary butcher is sacrificed. His special mechanic involves him teleporting around the hedge maze, taunting you to find him. (Bash to 'tag' him as 'found')
